title: Changing an entry's number on the Part Library page renames the part
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between two locations: the test location and location B.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test at the test location and at location B under the same part number, so both share one Part Library entry.
  • Use a new part number that no part and no Part Library entry has yet.
  • Start on the Part Library page (Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Click the pencil icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  4. Replace the Part Number with the new number.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Click Parts in the top bar.
  7. Click Part Library in the left menu.
  8. Type part A's old part number in the Search box.
  9. Replace the search text with the new number.
  10. Click Parts in the top bar.
  11. Click Inventory in the left menu.
  12. Type the new number in the Search box.
  13. Click the clock icon (Part History) at the left of the part A row.
  14. Pick location B in the location selector at the top right.
  15. Click Parts in the top bar.
  16. Click Inventory in the left menu.
  17. Type the new number in the Search box.
  18. Click the clock icon (Part History) at the left of the part A row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A's entry is listed.

Step 2:

  • The entry's detail page opens.

Step 3:

  • The "Edit Library Part" window opens.

Step 4:

  • Under the Part Number field the window shows "This also changes the part number at 1 other location."

Step 5:

  • The window closes and the detail page shows the new number.

Step 6:

  • The Parts left menu shows Part Library.

Step 7:

  • The Part Library page opens.

Step 8:

  • No entry is listed for the old number: no new entry was made for it.

Step 9:

  • One entry is listed, with the new number.

Step 10:

  • The Parts left menu shows Inventory.

Step 11:

  • The Inventory page opens.

Step 12:

  • Part A is listed under the new number, with the same bin and quantity it had before the rename.

Step 13:

  • Part History has a new entry "Part number updated | Original number:" with the old number, then "| New number:" with the new number, with your name, today's date and time, and nothing after the new number.

Step 14:

  • The location selector shows location B.

Step 15:

  • The Parts left menu shows Inventory.

Step 16:

  • Location B's Inventory page opens.

Step 17:

  • Part A is listed at location B under the new number too.

Step 18:

  • Location B's Part History has the same entry, ending "| Changed at:" followed by the test location's name as the location selector shows it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only), story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog), story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change)

  • S11-R3a: “Changing an entry's number or description on its detail page follows the part dialog's rules: S13-R12 to S13-R19, S13-N1, S13-N7, and S10-R23 to S10-R25.”
  • S13-R16: “When the user changes the part number and at least one other location stocks the same Part Library entry, the dialog shows, under the field, "This also changes the part number at {n} other locations.", or "This also changes the part number at 1 other location." for one.”
  • S13-R18: “Saving a changed number renames the part in place. The part keeps its identity, its history, and every line that holds it. Its Part Library entry is renamed with it, and its core takes the same number. No new Part Library entry is created.”
  • S10-R23: “A changed part number writes "Part number updated | Original number: {old} | New number: {new}" to the Part History of the part at every location that stocks it.”
  • S10-R25: “On the entries written at the other locations, the line ends with "| Changed at: {location}", naming the location where the change was made.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Part number changed on a part other locations stock | "This also changes the part number at {n} other locations." ("1 other location." for one) | Text under the field while it differs”
